title: exotic tunisian butter tagine
description: herbal, aerated, lazy-sunday tunisian dish featuring vegan butter, braise, ovo-vegetarian-friendly
instructions: heat 2 tablespoons of vegan butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
add the sliced shallots and cook for 5 minutes or until softened.
add the fresh parsley and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
transfer the mixture to the top of the tagine and cover with the lid.
bake in the preheated oven at 300f for 20 minutes or until the flavors are well combined.
season with salt and pepper to taste.
garnish with additional parsley if desired
serve with couscous or crusty bread for a hearty meal
optional: add 1/4 cup of chopped fresh cilantro for extra flavor
